summary: Mission San Juan Bautista is a Spanish mission located in San Juan Bautista, San Benito County, California. It was founded on June 24, 1797 by Fermín Lasuén of the Franciscan order. The note states it was the fifteenth Spanish mission established in present-day California and that it gave its name to the city.
one_line: Overview of Mission San Juan Bautista, a Franciscan Spanish mission founded in 1797 in San Benito County, California.
key_facts: Mission San Juan Bautista is a Spanish mission located in San Juan Bautista, San Benito County, California.
Mission San Juan Bautista was founded on June 24, 1797.
Mission San Juan Bautista was founded by Fermín Lasuén of the Franciscan order.
Mission San Juan Bautista was the fifteenth of the Spanish missions established in present-day California.
Mission San Juan Bautista is named for Saint John the Baptist.
The city of San Juan Bautista is named after Mission San Juan Bautista.
